1.consolidated_definition: Golilla a la que se ha entresacado la pluma cortándola de raíz para dificultar la picada del contrincante.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Feather pluck to which the quill has been excised by cutting it at the root in order to hinder the opponent's biting.
